name: parallel-gate-lifecycle-processfact-sync
title: Register the parallel-decomposition DEV gate in lifecycle + process-fact contract metadata
description: Follow-up from parallel-decomposition gate program Story 5 (B-086b, merged): S5 wired a real hard PLAN/INIT_CHECK/REVIEW/TEST->DEV block into machine.ts (parallelDecompositionEnforcedBlock / parallelDevEntryBlock consumed by canStartDevGuard, canSkipPlanGuard, canReenterDevGuard under parallelGate.mode==='block'). The runtime gate is verified correct, but two DESCRIPTIVE contract registries were left stale (they are out of S5's scope and not read for enforcement): (1) core/lifecycle-registry.ts LIFECYCLE_TRANSITIONS records the four DEV-entry transitions' gates but omits the new parallel-decomposition gate; (2) core/process-fact-levels.ts describes scope-contract facts as consumed only by REVIEW/TEST/DONE changed-file gates, while machine.ts now consumes them before every DEV entry; and scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs (run via npm run test:process-fact-contract; NOT in lattice validate) does not assert the new guard surface. This story syncs that metadata so audits/projections/drift-checks reflect the gate. Machine.ts's runtime guards are the source of truth — make the metadata match. Plus a brief doc note in docs/parallel-decomposition-spec.md §8.
